title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add your own 5 by 6 table to Session 1 and check the nearest person
body:
## Problem
Session 1 has a single table; a second table would show the method on different tastes.

## Context
Students learn faster from two examples than from one.

## Expected outcome
A second table (invented ratings, no real people) with a printed nearest person and recommendation.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Ratings are invented and the file says so
- [ ] The checkpoint still prints PASS

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: bias terms in ALS
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Students ask why popular items dominate the learned factors in Session 3.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: a smarter cold start
body:
## Problem
Session 3 switches between popularity and fold-in; a blend should do better with one rating.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where a new user gives 0 to 5 ratings and the blend is compared with both baselines.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Roadmap checkpoint met and shown in a figure
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a taste map with a live recommendation list
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a learned taste map and a recommendation list that updates; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Held-out error falls over the ALS sweeps in the animation
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
